title: BICM Architecture Adoption
decision: Adopt BICM v1.0 as the architectural framework for Bhavya AI Lab
reason: Need institutional memory, knowledge objects, universal compiler, and factory pattern for sustainable educational platform

alternatives.name: Keep ICM
alternatives.description: Continue with Interpretable Context Methodology as-is
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Lacks institutional memory, factory pattern, and knowledge object granularity

alternatives.name: Custom framework
alternatives.description: Build a completely custom educational framework
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Reinventing the wheel, BICM already addresses requirements

alternatives.name: Use existing LMS
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Not offline-first, not portable, not filesystem-based

outcome: BICM v1.0 adopted as architectural framework
impact: Full architecture rebuild required. Previous ICM work provides foundation but structure needs reorganization.
